text:
Anya R: Heads-up — traces are disappearing between gateway and async workers in batch fanout. Seen in prod for long-running jobs, spans end at gateway but workers show no parent. Repro with 5k queue messages. Anyone digging?
Matt G: saw similar last week with SQS retries — headers were truncated on redrive. Could be header size / encoding issue.
Sasha L: quick check: are we re-encoding `traceparent` or using our custom `x-redwood-trace`? Some services switch to base64 for batched payloads.
Anya R: Gateway currently injects `traceparent` + `tracestate` and also we add `x-rw-baggage` for routing hints. Worker lib expects `traceparent` only. If message body gets compressed we lose headers.
InfraBot: exporter-alert: sampling mismatch detected — 3.2% of traces lost between gateway->queue (last 24h).
Kevin T: probable culprits: SQS message attributes vs HTTP headers, SNS fanout rewriting message attributes, or Lambda layer stripping long attributes. Also note `tracestate` can exceed attribute size when baggage is big.
DevEx Maya: got a small repro: pushing 200 msgs with 2k of baggage each hits attribute cutoff. I can share logs.
Matt G: Proposal: canonicalize to a single compact header `x-rw-ctx` that is base64(<binary protobuf of traceparent+sampling+small-baggage>) and sign it. Workers decode + re-emit as `traceparent` locally.
Sasha L: :thumbsup: That would avoid attr size limits but adds work. Need versioned encoding and fallback when decode fails — don't drop the trace.
Anya R: Also think about keeping sampling decision with the task. If gateway sampled and worker decides not to start new trace, we still want to tag logs with trace id. So include explicit `sampled:1` bit.
Kevin T: Pseudocode for worker rehydration:
```python
hdr = msg.attributes.get('x-rw-ctx')
if hdr:
    raw = base64.b64decode(hdr)
    tp, samp, baggage = parse_proto(raw)
    tracer.inject(Context(tp, sampled=samp))
else:
    # fallback: try traceparent attr
    tracer.extract(msg.attributes.get('traceparent'))
```

DevEx Maya: We should add a validation step in gateway that rejects messages > 4KB attrs and fall back to embedding ctx in body with a small header. Also telemetry: count failures where decode fails and surface in console.
Matt G: Important: exporters may drop traces older than retention with partial parents; ensure our traceback includes a synthetic span that ties orphaned worker spans to the gateway using a stable identifier.
Sasha L: For rollout: feature-flag the new header encoding behind `rw.trace_bridge_v1` and do canary with 10% of traffic to Dedicated region. Add a fallback policy that preserves original headers.
Anya R: OK action items: 1) Matt + Kevin to draft `x-rw-ctx` proto and encode/decoder libs (go/python/node) 2) Sasha + DevEx to add console metric + alert for decode failures 3) Infra to instrument SQS attr size and redrive rewriting. I'll open a PR for feature flag. Thanks.
Kevin T: I'll also add a small tracer change: annotate rehydrated spans with `rw.trace.rehydrated=true` so we can query them.
Matt G: PR in progress, will ping channel when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: new canary flag `rw.trace_bridge_v1` enabled for infra/canary at 2024-06-06T16:12:00Z
Anya R: sweet — appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
